run_complete_cv_training: run the complete_cv_example.py script to train a ResNet50 on the Oxford-IIT Pet Dataset with Accelerate
create_accelerator_training: create an Accelerator instance with mixed precision, CPU/GPU support, and stateful dataloader configuration
build_pets_dataset: build a PetsDataset PyTorch Dataset that loads images from filenames and extracts labels from file names
test_checkpoint_resume: test resuming training from a checkpoint folder with epoch or step-based checkpointing strategies
refactor_training_loop: refactor the training loop to support multi-GPU, TPU, fp16, and fp32 modes via Accelerate
